title: Notifications
description: Reminders and notices from Sailock. They are stored encrypted on this device.
kind_update_body: Sailock {{version}} is available. You can install it from Settings → System.
kind_backup_body: It has been {{days}} days since your last backup. Export a copy from Settings.
kind_passwords_body: Reused: {{reused}} · Weak: {{weak}} · Old: {{old}}. Open your vault to review them.
clearDescription: All your notifications will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
selectHint: Select a notification to read it
notDismissibleHint: This notice can be deleted once you mark it as read.
kind_unknown_body: Sailock has a notice for you.
updateAlreadyDone: You already have the latest version.
kind_security_update_body: Sailock {{version}} includes security changes. We recommend installing it as soon as possible.
kind_backup_reminder_body: It has been {{days}} days since your last backup. Create one or set up automatic backups in Settings.
kind_backup_failed_title: Automatic backups are not being created
kind_backup_failed_body: You have gone {{days}} days without automatic backups. Check the destination folder and that Sailock is opened regularly.
kind_passwords_old_body: You have {{count}} passwords that haven't been updated in over 6 months. We recommend changing them.
kind_passwords_weak_body: Reused: {{reused}} · Weak: {{weak}}. Replace them with unique, longer passwords.
kind_twofa_disabled_body: Your two-step verification is off. Turn it on to protect your vault even if someone knows your master password.
kind_alert_failed_unlocks_body: Since your last sign-in there were {{count}} failed attempts to unlock your vault. If it wasn't you, change your master password.
kind_alert_totp_enabled_body: Two-step verification has been enabled on your vault.
kind_alert_totp_disabled_body: Two-step verification has been disabled. If it wasn't you, turn it back on and change your master password.
kind_alert_password_changed_body: The master password of your vault has been changed. If it wasn't you, change it again right away.
kind_alert_backup_codes_body: New backup codes have been generated for two-step verification.
kind_alert_export_body: An encrypted copy of your vault has been exported.
kind_alert_import_body: Data has been imported from a file.
kind_alert_backup_failed_body: The automatic backup could not be created. Check the destination folder and the backup password.
clearConfirmDescription: All your notifications will be deleted and this can't be undone. Enter your master password to confirm.
kind_alert_backup_code_used_body: A backup code was used to sign in. You have {{remaining}} left. If it wasn't you, change your master password and generate new codes.
